responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates and helper predicates used by TILE-Gx instruction patterns during recognition and expansion. The file classifies zero, pointer, net-register, immediate-range, symbolic, TLS, vector-duplicate, call, non-autoincrement, move, and comparison operands, including C-coded predicates for move legality and address form restrictions, giving tilegx.md and sync.md the target-specific operand tests they rely on.
